statements.t: In the short-term as a percentage of sales, we expect selling costs to remain relatively flat.
However, as anticipated positive regulatory developments in our core markets occur, we expect selling costs as a percentage of sales to decrease via growth in our retail and wholesale channels.

We expect general and administrative expenses as a percentage of sales to decrease as we realize revenue growth both organically and through anticipated positive regulatory developments in our core markets.
Current management forecasts and related assumptions support the view that we can adequately manage the operational needs of the business.

estimates.t: There have been no material changes to our critical accounting policies and estimates from the information provided in “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,” included in our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, as amended.

Based on information available to the Company as of November 10, 2026, Vireo Growth is issuing guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 and the first quarter of 2027 as follows:
For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect revenue to be in the range of $250 million to $265 million and Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $45 million to $48 million.

This guidance includes the results of FLUENT from November 9, 2026, the date the acquisition closed, and reflects an expected sequential decline in revenue from, and seasonality in, the Company’s non-cannabis business.
For the first quarter of 2027, we expect revenue to be in the range of $280 million to $300 million and Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $53 million to $56 million.

The Company has not provided an outlook for net income (loss), the most directly comparable GAAP measure to Adjusted EBITDA, or a reconciliation of its Adjusted EBITDA outlook to net income (loss), because it cannot do so without unreasonable efforts.

The outlook is based on assumptions including sales and pricing trends in the Company’s markets, an expected sequential decline in, and seasonality of, the Company’s non-cannabis business, the inclusion of FLUENT from November 9, 2026, the integration of recently completed acquisitions, operating costs and the Company’s effective tax rate.
The outlook is provided to help investors understand management’s current expectations for the Company’s near-term financial performance and may not be appropriate for other purposes.

If the Company continues to pursue acquisitions at a similar pace, it currently intends to provide guidance on a sequential, quarterly basis, generally together with its quarterly results, and does not intend to provide full-year guidance.
Except as required by applicable securities laws, the Company does not undertake to update the outlook.
Additional information relating to the Company’s third quarter 2026 results will be available on EDGAR and SEDAR+.
